related: collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle development during molting

definition: Synthesis and deposition of a collagen and cuticulin-based noncellular, hardened, or membranous secretion from an epithelial sheet, occurring as part of the molting cycle. An example of this process is found in Caenorhabditis elegans.
label: cuticle development involved in collagen and cuticulin-based cuticle molting cycle
